prompt: Below is the read path for an event-sourced Account service: an append-only log of AccountDeposited/AccountWithdrawn events per account, folded through a pure apply reducer into an AccountAggregate. Hot accounts have accumulated tens of thousands of events, and loadAccount's latency keeps climbing because every single call replays the account's entire history from version 1 all over again. Walk me through why this read path's latency is unbounded, then optimize it so latency stops growing with the length of the log — without ever making anything other than the append-only event log the source of truth. Name the trade-off you're accepting and how you'd verify the fix still reconstructs the exact same state from the log alone.
